correctness.rationale: For q>=3, identical compositions of two consecutive short arcs force both monochromatic, since each letter occupies one run and only two boundaries can connect both arcs. Reduction of arbitrary block periods modulo the primitive length, including complementary gaps for long residues, gives the exact iff phase set. Counting all monochromatic intervals gives N; primitivity and the ep<L constant-factor case give D. The complete proof treats boundary r=L/2, r=0, all positive run lengths, e>=2, and all p>=1. The verifier completed 74112 exhaustive and 800 additional independent brute configurations, plus a q=2 counterexample; tests are only corroboration.

value.rationale: The complete all-length/all-exponent phase and distinct-factor spectrum of a natural multi-symbol cyclic-run family answers fixed-period repetition-counting and avoidance questions. The sharp three-letter rigidity threshold is structural and cannot be deduced by parameter substitution from binary two-run formulas; classification covers infinitely many periods and all exponents, not a toy finite slice. Order-invariance of the spectrum is a meaningful corollary of the exact classification.
